title: Splitting schemes and estimators for stochastic differential equations with Hölder multiplicative noise
summary: We study parameter estimation for univariate stochastic differential equations with locally Lipschitz drift and Hölder continuous multiplicative diffusion, a class commonly arising in several applications. Existing inference methods typically rely on either the Euler-Maruyama discretisation, despite its lack of strong convergence and failure to preserve the state space, or on approximations, e.g. Gaussian approximation or truncation of Hermite's expansions, impacting on their stability and computational efficiency.
